claim: Where the key light sits. Direction does more for mood than colour does.
look_at: backlighting and rim are the most visually decisive. bottom (uplight) is the least reliable - the model tends to revert to conventional key lighting.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes

panels.clause: front lighting, flat even light on the face
side lighting, half the face in shadow, chiaroscuro
backlighting, subject against the light, rim lit
top lighting, harsh overhead, shadows under the eyes
